messages.subject: Dr. Jidenma | Mining, Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Jidenma,

Your leadership of Kestria's Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure practice across EMEA makes this a highly relevant introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where mining and energy operations intersect with government relations, ESG, social performance and country-facing execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My operating exposure also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage, carbon-data readiness, responsible mining and multi-agency regulatory coordination. Earlier experience in regulated financial services adds another dimension to my institutional and governance background.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership and related resource-sector functions. I am internationally mobile and open to GCC, Africa, Europe and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or upcoming searches where this background fits.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
